lip_sync_still_level: Normal articulation in wide and close stills.
gesture_vs_brief: Quiet take: hands rest throughout the wide section; the outward hand turn occurs late and falls below the close crop the brief specifies from "So". One blink/eyes-lowered still around "a decade ago" region.
likeness: Matches V5; the close crop is a 1:1 pixel crop of the 1080p source and looks slightly softer.
issues: Visible hand action in the close section is lost to the crop; wide alternate at final/alt/seg044-crop-plan-wide.mp4.

trim_decision.method: trim at the midpoint of native-minus-narration speech onset and speech end differences, capped so the trimmed native still covers the excerpt; envelope three-window offsets are in NATIVE-OFFSETS.json (weak correlations on several takes, so onset/end were used)

review_limitations: Still-level review only. Perceived lip sync, gesture timing against words and naturalness at normal speed were not judged and need human review with sound. Native Seedance speech ran longer than the narration, so body motion drifts relative to the words across the take (residuals listed).
